name: The turn
prompt: A patient of near three hundred pounds needs turning before his skin breaks down. The lift team is on another floor.

outcome.told: They come forty minutes later. The call lights stack up in the meantime.
You turn him on the count and wedge the pillows. Your arms shake after.

failure.told: Something in your lower back gives as he rolls. Occupational health sends you home, off work until it heals.
